items.title: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown
items.description: The market has been reacting to possible tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry following the US midterms

items.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
items.description: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".

items.title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
items.description: California has historically had the largest population of people on death row in the US.

items.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living

items.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
items.description: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

items.title: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey
items.description: Victims are found in several locations in three separate vehicles, according to local reports.

items.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
items.description: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.

items.title: Melania Trump calls for lasting Ukraine truce as she hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials
items.description: The US first lady was credited by all for playing a key though unspecified role in the ceasefire.

items.title: The Pitt and ER are similar enough for lawsuit to proceed, judge rules
items.description: The widow of ER creator Michael Crichton argues The Pitt is effectively a reboot of the 1990s series.

items.title: Pope Leo hosts Bob Dylan at official residence in Rome
items.description: Pope Leo had previously quoted Dylan's work in the preface of a book warning against nuclear rearmament.

items.title: Australia's oldest department store David Jones folds after 188 years
items.description: The brand's 38 physical stores and online site will continue to operate while receivers review its operations.
